name: 16-confirm-method-written
pack_def:
# Statistical gating with a constant-velocity Kalman filter per track.
# A pair is a candidate when the reported track lies inside the other track's
# predicted 99 % uncertainty region (chi-square, 2 degrees of freedom: 9.21),
# agrees on course, speed, height, simulation flag and environment, and does so
# on two consecutive reports. It stays grouped until it falls outside a wider
# region (chi-square 2 dof, 99.99 %: 18.42) on two consecutive reports.
pack           correlate-gnn
version        0.1.0
method         confirm
filter         accel_var=1 default_ce_m=50 vel_sigma_ms=5 unknown_vel_ms=100
gate           mahalanobis gate=9.21
gate           same key=track.simulated
gate           same key=@env
confirm        course max_deg=45 min_speed_ms=5
confirm        speed max_pct=40 min_speed_ms=5
confirm        altitude max_m=300
confirm_count  2
hold           mahalanobis gate=18.42
hold_failures  2
stale_ms       120000
same_source    forbid
output         priority
